channel.title: OpenPipes Demo: World News
channel.description: Fictional world headlines bundled with OpenPipes for demos and testing.

item.title: Heatwave Eases Across Southern Europe as Atlantic Rains Arrive
item.description: Temperatures dropped below 30C for the first time in three weeks, giving exhausted firefighting crews a chance to contain the remaining hotspots.

item.title: Global Markets Rally After Central Banks Hold Rates Steady
item.description: Equity indexes climbed to a six-month high as policymakers on three continents signalled that the tightening cycle has ended.

item.title: Underdogs Stun Champions in Continental Cup Semifinal
item.description: A stoppage-time header sent the tournament's lowest-ranked side into their first final, ending the holders' 21-match unbeaten run.

item.title: Coastal Cities Deploy Early-Warning Buoys Ahead of Storm Season
item.description: A network of solar-powered buoys will stream wave and pressure data to forecasters, promising up to six extra hours of evacuation lead time.

item.title: Grain Prices Fall as Harvest Forecasts Improve Worldwide
item.description: Wheat futures slid 8 percent after agencies raised yield estimates for the three largest exporters, easing food-inflation concerns.

item.title: Marathon World Record Falls on Rain-Soaked City Course
item.description: Despite steady drizzle, the 24-year-old champion shaved eleven seconds off the record, crediting a conservative first half and a late surge.

item.title: Trade Talks Resume With Green Tariffs Topping the Agenda
item.description: Negotiators returned to the table to discuss carbon border fees, with island nations pressing for exemptions on climate-adaptation goods.

item.title: Record Monsoon Rains Refill Reservoirs Across South Asia
item.description: Two weeks of above-average rainfall pushed major reservoirs past 90 percent capacity, ending water rationing in several metropolitan areas.
